## 1. Data acquisition, transformation and visualization

We download daily prices from Yahoo Finance starting from January 1, 2018 for:

- `BTC-USD` for Bitcoin
- `ETH-USD` for Ethereum
- `DX-Y.NYB` for the US Dollar Index
- `^VIX` for the VIX index
- `^IXIC` for the NASDAQ index
- `^IRX` for the IRX index

```{r download-data}
start_date <- as.Date("2018-01-01")
end_date   <- Sys.Date()

symbols <- c("BTC-USD", "ETH-USD", "DX-Y.NYB", "^VIX", "^IXIC", "^IRX")
getSymbols(symbols, src = "yahoo", from = start_date, to = end_date)

btc_px <- Ad(`BTC-USD`)
eth_px <- Ad(`ETH-USD`)
dxy_px <- Ad(`DX-Y.NYB`)
vix_px <- Ad(`VIX`)
nas_px <- Ad(`IXIC`)
irx_px <- Ad(`IRX`)

# Macro series do not contain weekend observations, so we align all series on common dates.
prices <- na.omit(merge(btc_px, eth_px, dxy_px, vix_px, nas_px, irx_px))
colnames(prices) <- c("BTC", "ETH", "DXY", "VIX", "NASDAQ", "IRX")
head(prices)
```

```{r plot-prices}
autoplot.zoo <- function(z, main = NULL) {
  df <- fortify.zoo(z)
  colnames(df)[1] <- "Date"
  df_long <- pivot_longer(df, -Date, names_to = "Series", values_to = "Value")

  ggplot(df_long, aes(Date, Value, color = Series)) +
    geom_line() +
    facet_wrap(~ Series, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = main, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

autoplot.zoo(prices, main = "Adjusted close prices")
```

### Computing log returns

```{r returns}
returns <- na.omit(diff(log(prices)))
colnames(returns) <- c("r_btc", "r_eth", "r_dxy", "r_vix", "r_nasdaq", "r_irx")
head(returns)
```

```{r summary-returns}

  main = "Returns summary: BTC, ETH, DXY, VIX, NASDAQ, IRX"
)
```


### Granger causality

```{r granger-tests}
g1 <- grangertest(r_btc ~ r_dxy,    order = 5, data = returns)
g2 <- grangertest(r_btc ~ r_vix,    order = 5, data = returns)
g3 <- grangertest(r_btc ~ r_nasdaq, order = 5, data = returns)
g4 <- grangertest(r_btc ~ r_irx,    order = 5, data = returns)
g5 <- grangertest(r_eth ~ r_dxy,    order = 5, data = returns)
g6 <- grangertest(r_eth ~ r_vix,    order = 5, data = returns)
g7 <- grangertest(r_eth ~ r_nasdaq, order = 5, data = returns)
g8 <- grangertest(r_eth ~ r_irx,    order = 5, data = returns)

g1; g2; g3; g4; g5; g6; g7; g8
```

## 3. Bayesian VAR-X model

### Organizing the data for Stan

We work in percentage returns for interpretability. This scaling is done **once only** here, avoiding the double-scaling issue in the rolling forecast section.

```{r prepare-data-stan}
returns_percentage <- returns * 100
data_mat <- as.matrix(returns_percentage)
n_total <- nrow(data_mat)

# Endogenous variables at time t
Y <- data_mat[-1, c("r_btc", "r_eth")]

# Lagged predictors available at time t-1
X_lagged <- data_mat[-n_total, ]

# Design matrix with intercept
X <- cbind(Intercept = 1, X_lagged)

cat("Checking alignment of dates:\n")
cat("Prediction for day:", rownames(Y)[1], "\n")
cat("Based on data of day:", rownames(X)[1], "\n")
```


```{r stan-data}
stan_data <- list(
  T = nrow(Y),
  K = ncol(X),
  M = ncol(Y),
  X = as.matrix(X),
  y = as.matrix(Y)
)
```

### Compiling the model

The revised Stan specification uses a non-centered prior for coefficients and an LKJ prior for the correlation structure of the covariance matrix.

```{r compile-model}
compiled_model <- stan_model(file = "bvarx_lkj_final.stan")
```

### Posterior sampling

```{r fit-model}
fit_test <- sampling(
  compiled_model,
  data = stan_data,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  chains = 4,
  thin = 2,
  seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 12)
)
```

Tr



### Geweke diagnostic
Here Geweke is done on all parameters, but tipically you need to check only the parameters that have been sampled (so z_beta and L_Omega)
```{r geweke-diagnostic}
posterior_array <- rstan::extract(fit_test, permuted = FALSE, inc_warmup = FALSE)
n_iter <- dim(posterior_array)[1]
n_chains <- dim(posterior_array)[2]
param_names <- dimnames(posterior_array)[[3]]


selected_idx <- seq_along(param_names)

geweke_results <- lapply(selected_idx, function(j) {

  z_by_chain <- sapply(1:n_chains, function(ch) {
    coda::geweke.diag(
      coda::as.mcmc(posterior_array[, ch, j])
    )$z
  })

  data.frame(
    parameter = param_names[j],
    chain = 1:n_chains,
    geweke_z = z_by_chain
  )
}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()


geweke_results
```

###Showing only the problematic parameters
```{r}
problematic_params <- geweke_results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(parameter) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(max_abs_z = max(abs(geweke_z))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(max_abs_z > 1.96)

problematic_params
```

###Interpretation of Omega


Correlation Matrix showing the residual correlation between btc and eth, so the shared dynamic of eth and btc that the model is not able to capture (that is all the correlation between the 2 because every coefficient is equal to zero)
```{r}
all_Omega <- grep("^Omega", dimnames(posterior_array)[[3]], value = TRUE)
omega_idx <- grep("^Omega", dimnames(posterior_array)[[3]])
Omega_samples <- posterior_array[, , omega_idx]
Omega_samples_2d <- matrix(
  Omega_samples,
  nrow = dim(Omega_samples)[1] * dim(Omega_samples)[2],
  ncol = dim(Omega_samples)[3]
)
M <- sqrt(dim(Omega_samples_2d)[2])

Omega_array <- array(NA, dim = c(nrow(Omega_samples_2d), M, M))

for (i in 1:nrow(Omega_samples_2d)) {
  Omega_array[i,,] <- matrix(Omega_samples_2d[i,], M, M)
}

Omega_mean <- apply(Omega_array, c(2,3), mean)
omega_mean_long <- melt(Omega_mean)


ggplot(omega_mean_long, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(value, 2)), size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "red",
    limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Posterior mean of Ω",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = "corr"
  )
```



### Residual diagnostics

Ljung-Box is applied to model residuals rather than to the original return series.

```{r residual-diagnostics}
beta_post_mean <- apply(rstan::extract(fit_test, pars = "beta")$beta, c(2, 3), mean)
y_hat <- X %*% beta_post_mean
resid_mat <- Y - y_hat
colnames(resid_mat) <- c("BTC", "ETH")

Box.test(resid_mat[, "BTC"], lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(resid_mat[, "ETH"], lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
acf(resid_mat[, "BTC"], main = "ACF residuals BTC")
pacf(resid_mat[, "BTC"], main = "PACF residuals BTC")
acf(resid_mat[, "ETH"], main = "ACF residuals ETH")
pacf(resid_mat[, "ETH"], main = "PACF residuals ETH")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

## 5. Out-of-sample forecasting

We use a rolling window of fixed size equal to 500 observations. The benchmark is the no-change forecast for returns, which corresponds to the random-walk benchmark on prices.

```{r rolling-forecast}
window_size <- 500
n_forecasts <- 30
total_obs <- nrow(Y)
start_idx <- total_obs - n_forecasts

forecast_results <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_forecasts, ncol = 2)
colnames(forecast_results) <- c("pred_btc", "pred_eth")

tau_history <- numeric(n_forecasts)
pred_draws_btc <- NULL
pred_draws_eth <- NULL

cat("Starting rolling window forecasting...\n")

for (i in 1:n_forecasts) {
  current_end <- start_idx + i - 1
  current_start <- current_end - window_size + 1

  Y_rolling <- Y[current_start:current_end, ]
  X_rolling <- X[current_start:current_end, ]

  stan_data_rolling <- list(
    T = nrow(Y_rolling),
    K = ncol(X_rolling),
    M = ncol(Y_rolling),
    X = X_rolling,
    y = Y_rolling
  )

  fit_rolling <- sampling(
    compiled_model,
    data = stan_data_rolling,
    iter = 1000,
    warmup = 500,
    chains = 2,
    thin = 2,
    refresh = 0,
    seed = 100 + i,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 12)
  )

  beta_draws <- rstan::extract(fit_rolling, pars = "beta")$beta
  sigma_draws <- rstan::extract(fit_rolling, pars = "sigma")$sigma
  L_Omega_draws <- rstan::extract(fit_rolling, pars = "L_Omega")$L_Omega
  n_draws <- dim(beta_draws)[1]

  if (i == 1) {
    pred_draws_btc <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_forecasts, ncol = n_draws)
    pred_draws_eth <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_forecasts, ncol = n_draws)
  }

  tau_history[i] <- mean(rstan::extract(fit_rolling, pars = "tau")$tau)

  X_next <- X[current_end + 1, , drop = FALSE]

  for (s in 1:n_draws) {
    beta_s <- beta_draws[s, , ]
    mu_s <- as.numeric(X_next %*% beta_s)
    L_Omega_s <- L_Omega_draws[s, , ]
    Sigma_s <- diag(sigma_draws[s, ]) %*% (L_Omega_s %*% t(L_Omega_s)) %*% diag(sigma_draws[s, ])
    y_pred_s <- mvtnorm::rmvnorm(1, mean = mu_s, sigma = Sigma_s)

    pred_draws_btc[i, s] <- y_pred_s[1]
    pred_draws_eth[i, s] <- y_pred_s[2]
  }

  forecast_results[i, 1] <- mean(pred_draws_btc[i, ])
  forecast_results[i, 2] <- mean(pred_draws_eth[i, ])

  cat("Forecast", i, "of", n_forecasts, "completed.\n")
}

real_values <- Y[(start_idx + 1):(start_idx + n_forecasts), ]
errori <- real_values - forecast_results
```

### Plotting forecasts

```{r plot-forecasts}
dates_forecast <- as.Date(rownames(real_values))
real_btc <- as.numeric(real_values[, 1])
real_eth <- as.numeric(real_values[, 2])
pred_btc <- forecast_results[, 1]
pred_eth <- forecast_results[, 2]

par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))

max_y_btc <- max(abs(c(real_btc, pred_btc)), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.3
plot(dates_forecast, real_btc,
     type = "l", col = "gray60", lwd = 2,
     ylim = c(-max_y_btc, max_y_btc),
     main = "Bitcoin: Real vs Predicted Returns",
     xlab = "", ylab = "Returns (%)", xaxt = "n")
lines(dates_forecast, pred_btc, col = "blue", lwd = 2)
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
axis.Date(1, at = seq(min(dates_forecast), max(dates_forecast), by = "1 week"), format = "%d %b")
legend("topright", legend = c("Real", "Prediction"), col = c("gray60", "blue"), lwd = 2, bty = "n")

max_y_eth <- max(abs(c(real_eth, pred_eth)), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.3
plot(dates_forecast, real_eth,
     type = "l", col = "gray60", lwd = 2,
     ylim = c(-max_y_eth, max_y_eth),
     main = "Ethereum: Real vs Predicted Returns",
     xlab = "Date", ylab = "Returns (%)", xaxt = "n")
lines(dates_forecast, pred_eth, col = "red", lwd = 2)
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
axis.Date(1, at = seq(min(dates_forecast), max(dates_forecast), by = "1 week"), format = "%d %b")
legend("topright", legend = c("Real", "Prediction"), col = c("gray60", "red"), lwd = 2, bty = "n")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

## 6. Forecast evaluation

### Point forecast metrics

```{r point-metrics}
errors_btc <- real_btc - pred_btc
errors_eth <- real_eth - pred_eth

rmsfe_btc <- sqrt(mean(errors_btc^2))
rmsfe_eth <- sqrt(mean(errors_eth^2))

mae_btc <- mean(abs(errors_btc))
mae_eth <- mean(abs(errors_eth))

cat("RMSFE Bitcoin:", round(rmsfe_btc, 4), "\n")
cat("RMSFE Ethereum:", round(rmsfe_eth, 4), "\n")
cat("MAE Bitcoin:", round(mae_btc, 4), "\n")
cat("MAE Ethereum:", round(mae_eth, 4), "\n")
```

### Random-walk benchmark on prices / zero-return benchmark on returns

```{r benchmark-metrics}
rw_pred_btc <- rep(0, n_forecasts)
rw_pred_eth <- rep(0, n_forecasts)

rw_errors_btc <- real_btc - rw_pred_btc
rw_errors_eth <- real_eth - rw_pred_eth

rmsfe_rw_btc <- sqrt(mean(rw_errors_btc^2))
rmsfe_rw_eth <- sqrt(mean(rw_errors_eth^2))

rel_rmsfe_btc <- rmsfe_btc / rmsfe_rw_btc
rel_rmsfe_eth <- rmsfe_eth / rmsfe_rw_eth

cat("Benchmark RMSFE Bitcoin:", round(rmsfe_rw_btc, 4), "\n")
cat("Benchmark RMSFE Ethereum:", round(rmsfe_rw_eth, 4), "\n")
cat("Relative RMSFE Bitcoin:", round(rel_rmsfe_btc, 4), "\n")
cat("Relative RMSFE Ethereum:", round(rel_rmsfe_eth, 4), "\n")
```

### CRPS

```{r crps}
crps_btc <- mean(scoringRules::crps_sample(y = real_btc, dat = pred_draws_btc))
crps_eth <- mean(scoringRules::crps_sample(y = real_eth, dat = pred_draws_eth))

cat("Mean CRPS Bitcoin:", round(crps_btc, 4), "\n")
cat("Mean CRPS Ethereum:", round(crps_eth, 4), "\n")
```

### Coverage of predictive intervals

```{r coverage}
lower_btc <- apply(pred_draws_btc, 1, quantile, probs = 0.05)
upper_btc <- apply(pred_draws_btc, 1, quantile, probs = 0.95)
lower_eth <- apply(pred_draws_eth, 1, quantile, probs = 0.05)
upper_eth <- apply(pred_draws_eth, 1, quantile, probs = 0.95)

coverage_btc <- mean(real_btc >= lower_btc & real_btc <= upper_btc)
coverage_eth <- mean(real_eth >= lower_eth & real_eth <= upper_eth)

cat("90% interval coverage BTC:", round(coverage_btc, 4), "\n")
cat("90% interval coverage ETH:", round(coverage_eth, 4), "\n")
```

### Hit ratio

```{r hit-ratio}
hit_btc <- mean(sign(real_btc) == sign(pred_btc))
hit_eth <- mean(sign(real_eth) == sign(pred_eth))

cat("Hit Ratio BTC:", round(hit_btc * 100, 2), "%\n")
cat("Hit Ratio ETH:", round(hit_eth * 100, 2), "%\n")
```

### Diebold-Mariano test against the benchmark

```{r dm-test}
dm_test_btc <- dm.test(errors_btc, rw_errors_btc, h = 1, alternative = "two.sided")
dm_test_eth <- dm.test(errors_eth, rw_errors_eth, h = 1, alternative = "two.sided")

print(dm_test_btc)
print(dm_test_eth)
```



## 7. Bayesian random walk benchmark

As an additional Bayesian benchmark, we estimate a random walk with drift model for **log-prices**. This is more coherent than imposing a random walk directly on returns. The one-step-ahead posterior predictive draw for the next log-price is then transformed into a return forecast.

### Compiling the Bayesian random walk model

```{r compile-bayesian-rw}
rw_model <- stan_model(file = "bayesian_rw_final.stan")
```

### Single full-sample estimation

```{r fit-bayesian-rw-full}
btc_logp <- as.numeric(log(prices$BTC))
eth_logp <- as.numeric(log(prices$ETH))

stan_data_rw_btc <- list(
  T = length(btc_logp),
  y = btc_logp
)

stan_data_rw_eth <- list(
  T = length(eth_logp),
  y = eth_logp
)

fit_rw_btc <- sampling(
  rw_model,
  data = stan_data_rw_btc,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,

)

  refresh = 0,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
)
```

###Geweke test

```{r}
# Estrazione array (permuted = FALSE è fondamentale per mantenere le catene separate)
posterior_array_btc <- rstan::extract(fit_rw_btc, permuted = FALSE, inc_warmup = FALSE)
n_chains <- dim(posterior_array_btc)[2]
param_names_rw <- dimnames(posterior_array_btc)[[3]]

# Selezione solo di mu e sigma (escludendo y_next e log_lik per pulizia)
idx_rw <- which(param_names_rw %in% c("mu", "sigma"))

geweke_btc <- lapply(idx_rw, function(j) {
  z_by_chain <- sapply(1:n_chains, function(ch) {
    coda::geweke.diag(coda::as.mcmc(posterior_array_btc[, ch, j]))$z
  })
  
  data.frame(
    parameter = param_names_rw[j],
    chain = 1:n_chains,
    geweke_z = z_by_chain
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

print("Geweke Test Results - BTC")
print(geweke_btc)

posterior_array_eth <- rstan::extract(fit_rw_eth, permuted = FALSE, inc_warmup = FALSE)

geweke_eth <- lapply(idx_rw, function(j) {
  z_by_chain <- sapply(1:n_chains, function(ch) {
    coda::geweke.diag(coda::as.mcmc(posterior_array_eth[, ch, j]))$z
  })
  
  data.frame(
    parameter = param_names_rw[j],
    chain = 1:n_chains,
    geweke_z = z_by_chain
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

print("Geweke Test Results - ETH")
print(geweke_eth)
```

### Rolling Bayesian random walk forecasts

```{r rolling-bayesian-rw}
bayesian_rw_rolling <- function(log_prices, train_size = 500,
                                n_forecasts = 30,
                                iter = 1000, warmup = 500,
                                chains = 2, seed = 900) {
  n <- length(log_prices)
  stopifnot(train_size + n_forecasts <= n)

  point_forecasts_ret <- numeric(n_forecasts)
  actual_returns <- numeric(n_forecasts)
  pred_draws_ret <- vector("list", n_forecasts)

  for (i in 1:n_forecasts) {
    end_idx <- train_size + i - 1
    y_train <- log_prices[1:end_idx]

    stan_data <- list(
      T = length(y_train),
      y = y_train
    )

    fit_rw <- sampling(
      rw_model,
      data = stan_data,
      chains = chains,
      iter = iter,
      warmup = warmup,
      seed = seed + i,
      refresh = 0,
      control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
    )

    post <- rstan::extract(fit_rw)
    y_next_draws <- post$y_next

    last_logp <- y_train[length(y_train)]
    ret_draws <- 100 * (y_next_draws - last_logp)

    pred_draws_ret[[i]] <- ret_draws
    point_forecasts_ret[i] <- mean(ret_draws)

    actual_returns[i] <- 100 * (log_prices[end_idx + 1] - log_prices[end_idx])
  }

  max_draws <- max(sapply(pred_draws_ret, length))
  pred_draws_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_forecasts, ncol = max_draws)

  for (i in 1:n_forecasts) {
    pred_draws_mat[i, 1:length(pred_draws_ret[[i]])] <- pred_draws_ret[[i]]
  }

  list(
    point_forecasts = point_forecasts_ret,
    actual_returns = actual_returns,
    pred_draws = pred_draws_mat
  )
}

rw_btc_res <- bayesian_rw_rolling(
  log_prices = as.numeric(log(prices$BTC)),
  train_size = start_idx,
  n_forecasts = n_forecasts,
  iter = 1000,
  warmup = 500,
  chains = 2,
  seed = 111
)

rw_eth_res <- bayesian_rw_rolling(
  log_prices = as.numeric(log(prices$ETH)),
  train_size = start_idx,
  n_forecasts = n_forecasts,
  iter = 1000,
  warmup = 500,
  chains = 2,
  seed = 222
)
```

### Bayesian random walk evaluation

```{r evaluate-bayesian-rw}
rw_bayes_errors_btc <- rw_btc_res$actual_returns - rw_btc_res$point_forecasts
rw_bayes_errors_eth <- rw_eth_res$actual_returns - rw_eth_res$point_forecasts

rw_bayes_rmsfe_btc <- sqrt(mean(rw_bayes_errors_btc^2, na.rm = TRUE))
rw_bayes_rmsfe_eth <- sqrt(mean(rw_bayes_errors_eth^2, na.rm = TRUE))

rw_bayes_mae_btc <- mean(abs(rw_bayes_errors_btc), na.rm = TRUE)
rw_bayes_mae_eth <- mean(abs(rw_bayes_errors_eth), na.rm = TRUE)

rw_bayes_crps_btc <- mean(
  scoringRules::crps_sample(
    y = rw_btc_res$actual_returns,
    dat = rw_btc_res$pred_draws
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

rw_bayes_crps_eth <- mean(
  scoringRules::crps_sample(
    y = rw_eth_res$actual_returns,
    dat = rw_eth_res$pred_draws
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

rw_bayes_lower_btc <- apply(rw_btc_res$pred_draws, 1, quantile, probs = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
rw_bayes_upper_btc <- apply(rw_btc_res$pred_draws, 1, quantile, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
rw_bayes_lower_eth <- apply(rw_eth_res$pred_draws, 1, quantile, probs = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
rw_bayes_upper_eth <- apply(rw_eth_res$pred_draws, 1, quantile, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

rw_bayes_cov_btc <- mean(
  rw_btc_res$actual_returns >= rw_bayes_lower_btc &
    rw_btc_res$actual_returns <= rw_bayes_upper_btc
)

rw_bayes_cov_eth <- mean(
  rw_eth_res$actual_returns >= rw_bayes_lower_eth &
    rw_eth_res$actual_returns <= rw_bayes_upper_eth
)

cat("Bayesian RW RMSFE BTC:", round(rw_bayes_rmsfe_btc, 4), "\n")
cat("Bayesian RW RMSFE ETH:", round(rw_bayes_rmsfe_eth, 4), "\n")
cat("Bayesian RW MAE BTC:", round(rw_bayes_mae_btc, 4), "\n")
cat("Bayesian RW MAE ETH:", round(rw_bayes_mae_eth, 4), "\n")
cat("Bayesian RW CRPS BTC:", round(rw_bayes_crps_btc, 4), "\n")
cat("Bayesian RW CRPS ETH:", round(rw_bayes_crps_eth, 4), "\n")
cat("Bayesian RW 90% coverage BTC:", round(rw_bayes_cov_btc, 4), "\n")
cat("Bayesian RW 90% coverage ETH:", round(rw_bayes_cov_eth, 4), "\n")
```

```{r compare-bvarx-vs-bayesian-rw}
  Asset = c("BTC", "BTC", "ETH", "ETH"),
  RMSFE = c(rmsfe_btc, rw_bayes_rmsfe_btc, rmsfe_eth, rw_bayes_rmsfe_eth),
  MAE = c(mae_btc, rw_bayes_mae_btc, mae_eth, rw_bayes_mae_eth),
  CRPS = c(crps_btc, rw_bayes_crps_btc, crps_eth, rw_bayes_crps_eth)
)

comparison_table
```
